_meta.acs: ACS 2024 1-year where published (places of 65k+; reference year 2024), otherwise ACS 2020–2024 5-year (B25031, B25064, B25077, B25103); www2.census.gov table-based summary files. Each city row records which vintage it uses.
_meta.bea: BEA Regional Price Parities 2024 (SARPP state, MARPP metro), apps.bea.gov
_meta.rentNote: ACS median GROSS rent (contract rent + utilities) of existing leases; asking rents on new leases run higher. The engine converts gross to contract rent.
_meta.propTaxNote: Median real estate taxes paid ÷ median home value (ACS), so a blended effective rate.
_meta.stateTax: Tax Foundation 2026 state brackets, standard deductions and exemptions (taxfoundation.org). Computed on gross wages with no federal-deduction add-backs, local income taxes or retirement/Social Security exclusions.

fields.rent: median gross rent by bedroom count (0 = studio … 4 = 4BR), USD/month
fields.rentMedian: median gross rent, all units, USD/month
fields.medianHome: median value of owner-occupied homes, USD
fields.propTaxPct: effective property tax, % of value per year
fields.rpp: metro BEA RPP for the principal city’s metro area (null when not matched → state RPP is used)
fields.childcare: annual center-based child care for 1, 2 and 3 children (MIT Living Wage; blended toddler/preschool/school-age)
fields.stateTax: per filing status: brackets [[floor, rate]], std deduction, personal exemption (or credit), plus dependent exemption
